scope: Completed cache-fix subagent delivery; no additional inference
finding: Request-local snapshots disappeared from later model inputs even though they were placed at the tail. Retaining immutable historical snapshots at their original conversation-prefix anchors restored cache growth in the measured native Codex runs.
limits: Warm subset does not replace complete-run totals; initial native cache misses remain included.
Archived snapshots remain in model context and add tokens; this is one active queue plus historical observations.
Long sessions and high notification volumes were not measured.
The controlled cache fixtures do not measure notification productivity benefits.
Default journal behavior is scoped to native openai-codex-responses; other providers remain unverified.
Existing single-section benchmark validators need adaptation before a full journal benchmark campaign.
This review does not retroactively establish the cause of every earlier pilot cache miss.
